title: Senior SQL Server Database Administrator
description:
Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SQL Server DBA to manage and support enterprise database platforms across on\-premise and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). The role is primarily centered around Microsoft SQL Server, while also requiring strong hands\-on experience in PostgreSQL and exposure to modern cloud\-native database services.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should operate as a cross\-skilled senior DBA, capable of working across multiple database technologies, supporting both SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments in production, and contributing to cloud\-native database operations. The role demands strong ownership of critical systems, along with the ability to adapt to evolving database platforms across relational and non\-relational ecosystems.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. SQL Server Administration \& Production Operations
 



 2\. Multi\-Cloud \& Managed Database Operations
 



 3\. Cross\-Skilled Database Operations (SQL \+ PostgreSQL \+ Cloud DBs)
 



 4\. Database Migration \& Modernization Support
 



 5\. Production Support \& Reliability
 



  





  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



  




* 8–10\+ years of strong SQL Server DBA experience
* Min 6\+ years of hands\-on working experience with PostgreSQL
* Proven expertise in performance tuning, HA/DR, and production system management
* Min 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Azure SQL, AWS RDS, or other managed database platforms
* Exposure to MySQL / MariaDB and modern cloud\-native databases
* Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, and scripting skills



  





 Automation \& DevOps Alignment
 



  





 • Support automation of database provisioning, monitoring, and maintenance tasks
 



 • Work with DevOps teams to integrate database operations within CI/CD pipelines
 



 • Use scripting (PowerShell, Python) for operational efficiency
 



 • Contribute to improving DBA processes through automation and standardization
 



 Professional Expectations
 



  





 • Strong ownership mindset for critical production systems
 



 • Ability to work across multiple database technologies and cloud environments
 



 • Effective collaboration with application, cloud, and DevOps teams
 



 • Team Player with a go getter mindset to contribute to project and practice initiatives
 



 • Clear communication during escalations, incidents, and production issues

title: Databricks Admin
description:
**Databricks Admin \- 6 to 18 years** 




 Location: Noida, Chennai, PAN India (in preference order)
 



  





**Desired Competencies (Technical/Behavioral Competency)** 




  




* Strong hands‑on experience with Databricks administration
* Strong problem‑solving and troubleshooting skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement



  





  





  





**Expectations from the Role** 




  




* Manage catalogues \& schemas: Create, alter, and delete catalogues and schemas; set ownership and default properties across the meta store.
* Access control \& governance: Define and manage permissions (GRANT/REVOKE) on catalogues, schemas, tables, views, volumes, and functions.
* Data security enforcement: Implement fine‑grained security using privileges, row filters, column masking, and tag‑based (ABAC) policies.
* Metadata \& data governance: Oversee table definitions, lineage, tags, classifications, and ensure compliance with governance standards.
* Administrative operations: Troubleshoot access issues, manage object ownership transfers, and support platform standards and best practices.
* Cross‑environment data copy: Move data securely from Prod to Non‑Prod using approved, automated pipelines.
* Data masking: Mask or anonymize sensitive fields (PII/PHI/PCI) during or before data copy.
* Deployments: Carryout deployments using CI/CD across various environments.
* Data upload: Upload data to DataBricks as well as migrate data from other Databases to it.

**Role Overview**
 The Senior SQL Server Developer with hands\-on experience in designs, builds, optimizes , and supports SQL Server solutions for CBA data processing, integrations, reporting, and production\-ready database components. This role requires strong SQL engineering judgment, query optimization, ETL/data processing, performance awareness, secure data handling, and the ability to use AI tools responsibly as a productivity accelerator while independently reviewing, validating , and correcting all AI generated outputs.
   

  

**AI capability requirement**
 Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of generative AI to accelerate SQL development, query troubleshooting, documentation, validation, and test support. AI\-generated code or analysis must be reviewed, corrected, secured, and explained before use .
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and support SQL Server database objects, including stored procedures, views, functions, jobs, triggers and data processing logic.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into efficient, maintainable SQL solutions aligned to CBA data patterns and release processes.
* Troubleshoot production and non\-production data issues, including performance, correctness, data quality, and integration concerns.
* Review execution plans, indexes, joins, filtering logic, transaction behavior, and data volumes to improve query performance and operational reliability.
* Partner with product owners, QA/SQA, developers, architects, and support teams to validate requirements, support testing, and ensure production readiness.
* Document technical designs, deployment considerations, operational dependencies, and support guidance for implemented solutions.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate routine development and analysis tasks, while validating correctness, security, performance, and business fit before implementation.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers and contribute to technical best practices.


**Re Quired Skills And Experience**
* Strong SQL Server development skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, stored procedures, query tuning, and execution plan analysis.
* Experience with data validation, source\-to\-target checks, reconciliation, exception handling, and root\-cause analysis for complex data issues.
* Ability to work in Agile delivery cycles, provide meaningful estimates, participate in sprint planning, and support defect resolution through release.
* Strong understanding of secure data handling practices, including preventing confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data from being entered into public AI tools.
* Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and validation outcomes to both technical and business stakeholders.

title: SAP-BODS-Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SAP\-BODS\-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data\-driven decision\-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS, working with SAP functional and technical consultants to analyze data migration requirements and design appropriate solutions. You will also provide advisory services to understand and address data management issues.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
* Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration challenges and optimize processes
* Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
* Managing data migration projects, including building, testing, and executing migrations with tools like SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
* Conducting preload and post\-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing strategies
* Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go\-live support
* Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Creating technical specification documents to guide the development of data services jobs
* Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools such as Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
* Advising clients on data management strategies and techniques to enhance data quality and optimize data management processes


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Data and Analytics solutions, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW/4HANA), SAP Data Intelligence, or related data platform credentials
* Demonstrating proficiency in Snaplogic for data migration
* Utilizing SAP BODS and LTMC for data migration projects
* Designing data migration solutions with SAP Data Services
* Managing data cleansing activities using Information Steward
* Analyzing complex data migration requirements and legacy data
* Excelling in data integration and data quality improvement plans

title: Senior DBA (SQL)
description:
BOLD seeks a senior professional to provide support for various MS SQL databases. This person will perform database structure and software maintenance and implementations, support database tuning and consultation, and assist with database configuration implementation. The person will also participate in incident, change, and problem\-management activities
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT THIS TEAM**
 Infrastructure team provides various services including automation, observability, cloud/server/network architectures, CICD, infrastructure as code, database administration, incident management, vendor management, security and compliance, and acquiring new skills. These services help to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and ensure fast and reliable application releases while maintaining security and compliance. TechOps help teams monitor applications and infrastructure, create resilient infrastructure, identify and resolve IT service issues, manage vendors, and ensure cloud security and compliance. The team also focuses on continuous learning and implementing new technologies to provide better value to the organization.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Enhancing the scalability and performance of existing database architecture.
* Protecting data by developing data security and restoration policies, procedures, and controls.
* Conducting diagnostic tests and evaluating performance metrics.
* Developing procedures to ensure data integrity and quality.
* Performing database maintenance, migration, and upgrading hardware and software.
* Documenting processes and complying with best practices in database management.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Strong understanding of SQL Server (IaaS and PaaS based on Azure) and on\-premise SQL Server setup.
* Strong understanding of Database concepts, SQL Architecture
* Automation experience with Powershell or Python
* Hands\-on experience in Unix/Linux command line options.
* Experience on DB migrations, maintenance and optimization strategies
* Experience in implementing operational automation using automation tools / scripts.
* Knowledge of indexes, index management, and statistics.
* Experience in Performance Tuning, Query Optimization, using Performance Monitor, SQL Profiler and other related monitoring and troubleshooting tools
* Ability to detect and troubleshoot SQL Server\-related CPU, memory, I/O, disk space and other resource contention.
* Experience in troubleshooting and resolving database integrity issues, performance issues, blocking \& deadlocking
* Experience with data modelling, database architecture and design
* Experience with backups, restores and recovery models.
* Knowledge of High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for Azuer PAAS,MSSQL Server
* Capacity Planning (Backup Share, Disk, CPU, Memory etc)
* Able to manage demanding stakeholders on technical solutions and align architects.


**EXPERIENCE\-**
* Sr. DBA \- 4\.5 years\+


**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**
* Competitive salary
* Tax\-friendly compensation structure
* Bi\-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company


**100% Full Health Benefits**
* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, \& term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage


**Flexible Time Away**
* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave

**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**
